translations.web: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
translations.bsb: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
translations.kjv: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
translations.asv: Then the lust, when it hath conceived, beareth sin: and the sin, when it is fullgrown, bringeth forth death.
